description: Authoritative round and board state machines (requirement 7.1, 7.2; simplified by D-53). Only the game service executes transitions; clients render projections. Admin-facing statuses: Draft (DRAFT), Registration open (REGISTRATION_OPEN), Playing (PLAYING), Finished (WINNER during the 12 s Bingo celebration, then CLOSED), Cancelled (CANCELLED). There is no LOCKED and no EXHAUSTED state: the start time (field lockAt) closes registration and starts play in one step, and every round ends with a winner.

transitions.guard: a start time in the future, or startInMinutes (the start time becomes now + startInMinutes)
new lockAt in the future, or extendMinutes 1-60 (from max(lockAt, now))
confirmed=true; boards with >= 1 skill play (blank spots never match), empty boards are DEFERRED; pool >= 5 (E20)
start time reached; same as round.start_now; if the pool is < 5 the round stays open and the admin is told (startBlocked)
drawNumber >= 4 and >= 1 board completes a line; or the pool is empty: the boards with the most matched tiles in one line win (ties are co-winners)

timers.name: lockAt (start time)
timers.effect: Starts the round (actor=system): boards lock and play begins; the admin then draws. If the pool is too small the round stays open once and startBlocked is set until the time changes.

invariants: Every mutating command carries commandId (idempotency key) and expectedVersion; a mismatch is rejected with STALE_VERSION (E10) and no mutation.
round.version increments exactly once per accepted mutating command.
Events are emitted only after the durable transaction commits (outbox).
No transition draws a skill except an accepted round.draw.next in PLAYING.
A published winner set is never recalculated; an invalid round is cancelled transparently.
round.deletion: DELETE /admin/rounds/{roundId} (any state) removes the round with its boards, cells, matches, draws, winners, Souls and float tokens; audit keeps one record; emits round.deleted. POST /admin/events/{eventId}/reset (non-production only) clears every round, participant and Soul of the event; emits event.reset.

states.READY: 16 selections with server-randomized positions; registration still open; editable (returns to DRAFT)
states.LOCKED_ACTIVE: At round start: READY boards, and DRAFT boards with 1-15 skills (server places them at random positions; the other spots stay blank and never match). Included in the draw pool and evaluation; immutable
states.DEFERRED: No skill at round start, or arrived after the start; preserved and reassigned to the next eligible round

transitions.guard: 0-16 unique active skills; Platform and Role selected (E16); round not locked (E8)
exactly 16 unique; server assigns positions; matrixVersion snapshot
any change clears positions; identical set is a no-op
atomic with all boards of the round
>= 1 skill; server randomizes the skills into 16 positions, the rest blank (D-53)
selections retained; positions cleared; requires new finalize
